verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a public REST API for running AI browser tasks, creating sessions and registering custom tools. Its API reference includes concrete endpoints: list tasks, cancel task, send event (run_task, goto, extract, evaluate_js, close), a sessions API and a documented polling model, plus an SDK quickstart. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec found at common paths, and no independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
